Short title extent and commencement

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT,
1996
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend and consolidate
the law for the control of timber and establishment of sale deposits and sawing
units for timber in the North‑West Frontier Province
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17146, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The North‑West Frontier (Sale and
Sawing of Timber) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
the North‑West Frontier Province on the 6th October, 1996 and assented to
by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province or lie 14th October,
1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West
Frontier Province.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province (Sale and Sawing of Timber) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall extend to whole of
the North‑West Frontier Province.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17146, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The North‑West Frontier (Sale and
Sawing of Timber) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
the North‑West Frontier Province on the 6th October, 1996 and assented to
by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province or lie 14th October,
1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West
Frontier Province.
2. Definition.‑‑(1)
In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires,‑‑‑
(a) "Division" means a
Forest Division having jurisdiction over the area where sale depots or sawing
units for timber are established under this Act;
(b) "Divisional Forest
Officer" means the Forest Officer incharge of the Division concerned;
(c) "Government" means
the Government of the North‑West Frontier Province;
(d) "prescribed" means
prescribed by rules made under this Act;
(e) "sale depot" means
any building or place where timber is brought and stored for sale; and
(f) "sawing unit" means
a saw mill or a saw machine where timber is cut, sawn or fashioned.
(2) Other expressions used in
this Act but not defined shall have the same meanings as are assigned to them
in the Forest Act, 1927 (Act No.XVI of 1927), or the Hazara Forest Act, 1936
(N.‑W.F.P. Act No.VI of 1937), as the case may be.

[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,

No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17146, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The North‑West Frontier (Sale and
Sawing of Timber) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
the North‑West Frontier Province on the 6th October, 1996 and assented to
by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province or lie 14th October,
1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West
Frontier Province.
3. Restriction on
establishment of a sale depot or a sawing unit.‑‑(1) There
shall not be established a sale depot or a sawing unit, unless the same is
registered in such manner and on payment of such fee as may be prescribed.
(2) A Divisional Forest Officer
may, for reasons to be recorded in writing, refuse to register a sale depot or
a sawing unit or cancel the registration of an existing sale depot or a sawing
unit:
Provided that no order under this
subsection shall be made without giving the owner of the sale depot or the
sawing unit, as the case may be, an opportunity of being heard.
(3) Where registration of a sale
depot or a sawing unit is cancelled under subsection (2), or it has expired,
the sale depot or the sawing unit, as the case may be, shall cease to function
or operate, except in the case of expiry of registration, if the owner of the
sale depot or the sawing unit, as the case tray be, has, in the prescribed
manner, applied for renewal of the registration and hip request for renewal has
not been refused:
Provided that no request for
renewal shall be refused without apprising the owner of the sale depot or the
sawing unit concerned of the reasons for refusal and without giving him an
opportunity of being heard.

4. Maintenance of record.‑‑(1)
Every owner of a sale depot or a sawing unit shall maintain such record or keep
such register as may be prescribed.
(2) The record or register being
maintained under subsection (1) shall be open to inspection by such officers as
may be authorised by Government.

6. Offences and penalties.‑‑(1)
Contravention of any of the provisions of this Act or the rules made thereunder
shall constitute an offence rendering the offender liable to imprisonment for a
term which shall not be less than three months and may extend to two years, or
to fine which shall not be less than one thousand rupees and may extend to ten
thousand rupees, or with both, and may further entail seizure and confiscation
of illicit timber as well as seizure dismantling, sealing and confiscation of
the apparatus or machinery used in the contravention:
Provided that u, here the offence
is committed after the sunset and before the sunrise or when the offender
causes hindrance in the performance of lawful duties under this Act or has been
previously convicted of a like offence, he may be inflicted with double the
penalties specified above.
(2) Any Forest or Police Officer
may arrest, without warrant, any person committing within his sight an offence
punishable under this Act.
(3) Every officer making an
arrest under this section shall, without unnecessary delay, take or send the
person so arrested to the nearest Magistrate or Police Station.

9. Application of certain
provisions of the Forest Act, 1927 and the Hazara Forest Act, 1936.‑‑The
provisions of Chapter IX of the Forest Act, 1927, with the exception of section
62, and Chapter VII of the Hazara Forest Act, 1936, with the exception of
sections 34 to 38 and section 47, shall apply, so far as may be, to airy infringement
of the rules made under this Act as if such infringement were a forest offence
under the respective Acts.

NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE (SALE AND SAWING OF TIMBER) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend and consolidate
the law for the control of timber and establishment of sale deposits and sawing
units for timber in the North‑West Frontier Province
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17146, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The North‑West Frontier (Sale and
Sawing of Timber) Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
the North‑West Frontier Province on the 6th October, 1996 and assented to
by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province or lie 14th October,
1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West
Frontier Province.
10. Power to make rules.‑‑(1)
Government may make rules to carry out the purposes of this Act.
(2) Without prejudice to the
generality of the foregoing provisions such rules may provide for all or any of
the following matters, namely‑‑
(a) the classes of Timber to
which the rules shall apply;
(b) establishment, registration,
regulation and inspection of sale depots and sawing units;
(c) fee for registration,
including the renewal fee and the period for which the registration shall hold
good;
(d) conditions under which timber
may be brought to, stored at, and removed from, sale depots, or cut, sawn or
fashioned at a sawing unit;
(e) specification of Timber, the
sale, cutting, sawing or fashioning whereof is prohibited;
(f) form of registers to be
maintained at the sale depots and sawing units;
(g) security to be pledged with
the Divisional Forest Officer for the establishment of sale depots and sawing
units; and
(h) seizure and sealing of
unregistered sale depots and sawing units, including dismantling thereof and
confiscation of timber and appliances found therein.

11. Repeal and saving.‑‑(1)
The Punjab Forest (Sale of Timber) Act, 1913, in its application to the North‑West
Frontier Province (Sale and Sawing of Timber) Ordinance, 1996 (N.‑W.F.P.
Ordinance No.V of 1996) are hereby repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of
the Act mentioned in subsection (1), everything done, action taken, obligation,
liability, penalty or punishment incurred, inquiry or proceeding commenced,
officers appointed or person authorised, jurisdiction or power conferred, rule
made and order or notification issued under any of the provisions of the said
Act, shall, if not inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, be continued,
and so far at; may be, be deemed to have been respectively done, taken,
incurred, commenced, appointed, authorised, conferred, made or issue under this
Act.
